name: (Spring-Heeled Jack) Resonant Terror

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Monsters of Myth

text: Spring-Heeled Jack glares at a creature he can see within 30 feet. The target must immediately attempt a Will save save (DC equal to the DC of Jack's Breath Weapon) or become Frightened 1 (Frightened 2 on a critical failure), and it can't reduce its frightened condition below 1 for 24 hours or until this curse is removed. After attempting its save, the creature is temporarily immune to this ability for 24 hours.
